guards.what: N2: the `isMimicked` parameter of TryModifyRestSiteHealRewards, and the C# return value
guards.rationale: TinyMailbox ignores `isMimicked` entirely -- it adds the two potions whether the heal came from the rest site or from PlayerCmd.MimicRestSiteHeal (PlayerCmd.cs:264) -- so a port that also ignores it is correct, and the sim's hook signature (run, rewards) drops a parameter no implementer here reads. The `return true` is the Try-chain's 'I modified something' flag, which audit/records/seam/hook_dispatch.json step 34 already verdicts as a deliberate-divergence collapsed into a void mutator across the whole family; matched here rather than re-derived (binding rule 3). Rule 7: PlayerCmd.cs and audit/records/seam/hook_dispatch.json are not hashed here.

guards.what: N3: `rewards.Add(new PotionReward(player))` TWICE rather than one two-potion reward
guards.rationale: Recorded for whoever implements G1: they are two independent take-or-skip offers, not a pick-one-of-two, so the fix is two appends to CombatRewards.special_potions (which driver.py:583 already offers one at a time) and NOT the single `rewards.potion` pity slot. Each PotionReward rolls its own potion, so the fix also costs two potion-generation draws -- relevant to RNG parity, and the reason a one-line 'give 2 potions' shortcut would be wrong.
